resources.string: This is a MODIFIED version of the program. It is not the original program, and it is not endorsed by, affiliated with, or associated with Electronic Arts Inc.

Command & Conquer and Command & Conquer Red Alert were created by Westwood Studios.

Copyright 2020 Electronic Arts Inc.

Electronic Arts released the engine source code under the GNU General Public License v3 with additional terms. On 27 February 2025 EA released the fully recovered original source for both games under the same licence.

Android port by Michael Pricharda.\n\nModifications are confined to the platform layer: windowing and display, touch input, audio backend, and filesystem paths. No game logic, balance, mission data or rules were altered.

Vanilla Conquer — the portable engine this port is built on, by The Assembly Armada and contributors.

SDL2 by Sam Lantinga and the SDL contributors, under the zlib licence. Used unmodified.

OpenAL Soft, under the GNU Library General Public License v2. Used unmodified and linked dynamically, so it can be replaced.

An earlier Android port of Vanilla Conquer by the GitHub user sandstranger was read as a reference for how the platform layer could be structured. No code was copied from it, but the debt is real and is acknowledged here.

This application contains NO game data. Artwork, audio, video and mission files remain the property of Electronic Arts Inc. and are not distributed with it.\n\nYou must supply your own data files from a copy of the games you obtain yourself. This is permanent and deliberate, not a limitation that will later be removed.

Command & Conquer, Tiberian Dawn, Red Alert and Electronic Arts are trademarks of Electronic Arts Inc.\n\nThose marks are used here only to identify the game data this engine reads. They are not used as the identity of this application, which is named Command Post.

This program is free software under the GNU General Public License v3, with additional terms imposed by Electronic Arts Inc. under section 7 of that licence. The full text of both follows below.\n\nComplete corresponding source for this exact build, including every platform-layer modification and the scripts used to build it, is available from the project repository.
